uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Tenacity is increased by 50% while the user has a shield. When the user hits an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack or move, the user's critical-hit rate increases by 5% up to 5 times for a maximum of 25%. This enhanced critical-hit rate remains for up to 8s after the user last dealt damage with a basic attack or move. As a Farfetch'd, the user will gain 10 Exp. Points when landing critical hits. This Exp. can trigger evolution. Critical hits deal 160% damage rather than 200%.
The user attacks by slashing with a leek. This Pokémon has no boosted attack.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
The user slashes in the designated direction, if the first hit lands then the user can use this move again within 5s to slam the leek in the designated spot.

The user unleashes a flurry of jabs in the designated direction, with the damage increasing by 3% each time the move deals damage up to 2 times (6% max). The final hit stuns opposing Pokémon for 0.75s. Sirfetch'd can move while unleashing the flurry of jabs. If the move is interrupted, 50% of the remaining cooldown is refunded.
Increases the damage of this move.

The user jabs in the designated direction, if the first hit lands then the user can use this move again within 10s to dash and slash in a designated direction, throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 0.5s. If the first hit of this move misses, the cooldown is instead 2s.
Increases the damage of this move.
The user dashes towards the designated Pokémon, dealing damage and gaining a shield for 3s.

The user throws the leek-leaf shield in an arc, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit. When the leek-leaf shield returns the user gains a shield for 4s. While the leek-leaf shield is mid-flight it can continuously inflict damage to the same opponent every 0.5s. Alternatively, this move can be used again within 1.5s while the leek-leaf shield is mid-flight causing the user to leap to where the shield is and slam it into the ground dealing damage in an area, applying a 70% slow for 3s, and granting the user a shield for 4s.
Improves the strength of the shield.

Has the user ready the leek-leaf shield while the move button is held down, for 0.6s the user is Impervious, negating damage received, afterwards the user instead reduces damage received by 30% for up to 2.4s. When the move button is released the user dashes in the designated direction dealing damage. If the user blocks an attack, the second stage of the move will apply a 50% slow for 2.5s, and grant a shield for 4s. If an attack is blocked while the user is Impervious, the cooldowns for Fury Cutter and Leaf Blade are reduced by 50% of their max cooldown.

The user becomes Unstoppable, as well as maxing out the Steadfast gauge, and charges in the designated direction, shoving any opposing Pokémon along the way for up to 1s, dealing damage to them up to 5 times. If this move does damage near the end of the dash an explosion occurs dealing double damage and stunning opponents in the area for 0.4s. This move can go through walls if there is enough distance left.
